facts.statement: Workforce access is a separate capability from pay-data reporting. Controller checks WorkforceInternalCosting entitlement and family-specific view/manage claims; department admin satisfies these claim predicates. Pay-data reporting separately needs its capability and Enabled ADP. This plan never changes those settings.

Normal sidebar Workforce entry opens /User/Workforce; shared tabs expose Employer, Establishments, Workers, Compensation, Work entries, Resource costs and Cost runs according to access. A visible tab does not prove manage permission.

Employer Save updates the one active department profile, including all posted coverage/headcount/contact/address values; it is not an append-only demonstration. Legal name required; nonblank NAICS must be six digits. Retain existing declared Unknown/Not declared and blank sensitive values.

Establishments require Code and Name, a unique case-insensitive Code and non-reversed active dates; optional NAICS must be six digits. Time zone, State and activity are stored operational fields; no geocoding/provider call occurs in this save method.

Employer tax identifiers and filing contact, compensation values/components and approved payroll cost are protected accessor fields. Current Establishment and Worker accessor maps are empty. Operational employer addresses are plaintext in this source. New rows with all protected accessor values empty save without an envelope write; this is not a grant or security bypass. Nonempty protected input must use normal authorized product behavior; stop on refusal/redaction.

Add worker offers active not-yet-linked members. Selecting a member uses GetOrCreateWorkerForUserAsync and ignores optional external-key/display-label inputs on that branch. It creates only a Workforce worker link, not a new account, department member, personnel role or crew assignment. Without a member, external worker identity requires a nonblank external key.

An employment period belongs to a worker. End equal to Start is accepted; reversed dates and inclusive overlapping sibling periods are refused. Labor contractor employee requires a contractor. Default establishment must belong to the department. Personnel role here resolves compensation defaults; saving it does not edit actual personnel membership or active staffing.

Add assignment is entered from the employment panel. It initially copies employment Start and default establishment but independently defaults WorkCountry US and WorkSubdivision CA. Set the intended State explicitly. Save rejects reversed dates and inclusive overlapping sibling assignments, checks establishment ownership, validates nonblank CRD job-category code and enum Work mode. It does not enforce containment within the parent employment dates; use matching one-day bounds in this exercise.

CRD job category, SOC and Cal OES MARS mapping fields serve separate reporting/mapping purposes. Leave them blank for this fictional IL exercise; a job title is not a certification or coverage finding. Mapping provenance can identify a software demonstration only.

Compensation has Employee, Role default and Department default profiles. Employee Add profile binds only this employment. A same-subject scope cannot have overlapping profile dates. Employee form clears role; Role default clears employment. Avoid department/role defaults for an isolated member exercise.

Profile and component lists save in one transaction. Full submitted pay/cost component lists replace prior desired sets: omitted existing components are soft-deleted. Every component save unapproves the profile, even an unchanged/empty set. Saved blank-rate profiles cannot establish a complete loaded cost.

Approve profile is a separate normal HTML form POST, not a native confirm. Service refuses the creator/last editor and refuses a worker approving their own employee profile. Boden cannot approve a profile Boden just created for Casey. Do not alter roles/accounts or attempt alternate identity to manufacture a success.

For a dated workload, an employee profile is chosen first, then the role default, then department default. Unapproved profiles can price with review reasons; inaccessible protected values are blanked and flag NoRate rather than bypassing protection. The optional approved payroll-cost number overrides estimated labor cost when available; do not fill it in this software example.

evidence.anchor: public async Task<(EmployeeCompensationProfile Profile, bool IsFallback)> ResolveProfileAsync

facts.statement: Work entries are saved per worker/date and allow 0–24 hours. Blank employment is auto-resolved to a nondeleted period covering that date. US/CA defaults apply here too. The page has no general note field; a fictional External source/id can label a software-only row. A matched nonblank External source+id may update an existing row. Approved checkbox and approved payroll cost are distinct; leave both unset. Work-entry approval is not a payroll payment.

Resource cost profiles are plain numeric internal-cost configuration, distinct from personnel compensation and inventory quantities. Unit subject requires a department unit. Other subjects require an asset id or external resource key. Same subject cannot have overlapping dated profiles. Nonnegative values are required; saved depreciation is straight line. A new profile may set Approved via checkbox; keep it OFF.

Resource-cost component save uses the submitted list as the complete desired set; omitted old rows are soft-deleted. Controller saves the profile first, then component list in separate calls; there is no all-or-nothing controller transaction here. Use new-only clean data and verify reopened profile/list, not just a toast.

Resource usage requires a call or deployment context and unit subject needs a unit. Source/phase/subject enums and nonnegative readings are validated; distance is canonicalized to miles, engine hours may derive from meters. Conflicting manual/automatic distances can flag both rows. Context-only or unsaved unit toggles prove no reading was saved. Avoid original active-call contexts.

Calculate/Estimate creates saved cost-run data, not a read-only preview. Call calculation refuses an empty input context, then consumes work entries/usage. Deployment calculation uses approved/billed daily reports, usage/expenses through the date, not a draft report as proven actual labor. Bid estimation uses bid lines and resource/compensation fallbacks. Missing inputs produce Needs review, otherwise Draft.

Recalculation soft-deletes prior unfrozen runs and deletes their lines for the same context/run type. Frozen prior runs remain referenced. Freeze is a native JavaScript confirm then POST; it may supersede an earlier frozen run and cannot be deleted through normal Delete. Do not calculate/freeze merely to inspect existing runs.

The traced employer/worker/employment/assignment/profile/work-entry/resource/run actions call repository saves and audit publication. They are separate from invoice, payroll delivery and statutory export/report actions. This bounded plan claims only saved software configuration/readback, not employment status correctness, money paid, physical work, legal coverage or compliance.
